lessons.name: Breakfast
lessons.description: What Bulgarians eat in the morning, and the verbs "ям" and "пия".

multiple_choice.name: Match the breakfast food
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Butter and honey
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: За закуска ям филия с __ и мед.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "За закуска ям филия с масло и мед." means "For breakfast I eat a slice of bread with butter and honey."

true_false.name: True or false: Zakuska
true_false.explanation: Correct. "Закусвам" means "I have breakfast".

fill_in_the_blank.name: A glass of milk
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Сутрин пия чаша мляко." means "In the morning I drink a glass of milk."

fill_in_the_blank.name: The children eat banitsa
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Децата ядат баница за закуска." means "The children eat banitsa for breakfast." Децата is plural.

true_false.name: True or false: Yaytse
true_false.explanation: Яйце is singular and neuter. The plural is яйца.

multiple_choice.name: Match more breakfast food
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Coffee without sugar
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Обичам кафе без захар." means "I like coffee without sugar."

true_false.name: True or false: Kiselo mlyako
true_false.explanation: Correct. Bulgarian yoghurt is famous for its bacterium, Lactobacillus bulgaricus.

fill_in_the_blank.name: What is there for breakfast
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Какво има за закуска днес?" means "What is there for breakfast today?"

lessons.name: Lunch and Dinner
lessons.description: Main meals, cooking verbs and adjectives for food.

multiple_choice.name: Match the meals
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Chicken with rice
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: На обяд ядем пиле с __ и салата.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "На обяд ядем пиле с ориз и салата." means "For lunch we eat chicken with rice and salad."

true_false.name: True or false: Vecherya
true_false.explanation: Correct. "Вечерям" means "I have dinner".

fill_in_the_blank.name: I am cooking dinner
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Тази вечер аз __ вечеря за всички.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Тази вечер аз готвя вечеря за всички." means "Tonight I am cooking dinner for everyone."

fill_in_the_blank.name: Very hot soup
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Супата е много __ и не мога да я ям.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Супата е много гореща и не мога да я ям." means "The soup is very hot and I cannot eat it." Супа is feminine.

true_false.name: True or false: Pile
true_false.explanation: "Пиле" means "chicken". Fish is "риба".

multiple_choice.name: Match the cooking verbs
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English verb to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Mum bakes bread
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Мама пече хляб в неделя." means "Mum bakes bread on Sundays."

true_false.name: True or false: Parzheni kartofi
true_false.sentence: "Пържени картофи" are chips, or French fries.
true_false.explanation: Correct. Literally, "fried potatoes".

fill_in_the_blank.name: Grilled meatballs
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Обичам печени кюфтета с картофи." means "I love grilled meatballs with potatoes." Кюфтета is plural.

lessons.name: Drinks
lessons.description: Order drinks, count bottles and glasses, and describe tastes.

multiple_choice.name: Match the drinks
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each drink to its Bulgarian word.

fill_in_the_blank.name: A bottle of water
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Една бутилка вода, моля." means "A bottle of water, please."

true_false.name: True or false: Mineralna voda
true_false.sentence: "Минерална вода" can be still or sparkling ("газирана").
true_false.explanation: Correct. Still water is "негазирана".

fill_in_the_blank.name: Coffee with milk
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Искате ли кафето с мляко?" means "Would you like your coffee with milk?"

fill_in_the_blank.name: Two cups of tea
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Две чаши чай, моля." means "Two cups of tea, please." Чаша is feminine, so the number is две.

true_false.name: True or false: Sok
true_false.explanation: "Сок" means "juice". Soup is "супа".

multiple_choice.name: Match the tastes
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English adjective to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Bitter tea
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Чаят е много горчив без захар." means "The tea is very bitter without sugar." Чай is masculine.

true_false.name: True or false: Ayryan
true_false.sentence: "Айрян" is a drink made of yoghurt and water.
true_false.explanation: Correct. It is a cold, slightly salty drink, popular with a banitsa.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Cold beer
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Бирата е студена и приятна." means "The beer is cold and pleasant." Бира is feminine.

lessons.name: Hungry and Thirsty
lessons.description: Say how you feel before and after a meal.

multiple_choice.name: Match the feelings
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English adjective to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: I am hungry
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Гладна съм и искам да ям." means "I am hungry and I want to eat." A woman says гладна, a man гладен.

true_false.name: True or false: Zhaden sam
true_false.explanation: Correct. A woman says "Жадна съм".

fill_in_the_blank.name: The children are thirsty
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Децата са жадни и искат вода." means "The children are thirsty and want water."

fill_in_the_blank.name: I am full
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Благодаря, __ съм и не искам повече.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Благодаря, сит съм и не искам повече." means "Thank you, I am full and do not want any more."

true_false.name: True or false: Gladen sam for a woman
true_false.sentence: A woman says "Гладен съм" when she is hungry.
true_false.explanation: A woman says "Гладна съм". The adjective agrees with the speaker.

multiple_choice.name: Match the mealtime phrases
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English phrase to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Let's have a bite
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Хайде да хапнем нещо!" means "Let's have a bite to eat!"

true_false.name: True or false: Dobar apetit
true_false.sentence: "Добър апетит" is said before a meal.
true_false.explanation: Correct. It is like "Enjoy your meal" or "Bon appétit".

fill_in_the_blank.name: Something in the fridge
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Имаш ли нещо за __ в хладилника?
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Имаш ли нещо за ядене в хладилника?" means "Have you got anything to eat in the fridge?"

lessons.name: Laying the Table
lessons.description: Plates, cutlery and passing things at the table.

multiple_choice.name: Match the tableware
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Soup with a spoon
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Супата се яде с __ от дълбока чиния.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Супата се яде с лъжица от дълбока чиния." means "Soup is eaten with a spoon from a deep plate."

true_false.name: True or false: Nozh
true_false.explanation: Correct. The plural is ножове.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Six plates
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Сложи шест чинии на масата, моля." means "Put six plates on the table, please."

fill_in_the_blank.name: A fork for the salad
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Може ли една вилица за салатата?" means "Could I have a fork for the salad?"

true_false.name: True or false: Salfetka
true_false.explanation: A салфетка is a napkin. A tablecloth is a "покривка".

multiple_choice.name: Match more table words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Pass the salt
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Подай ми солта и пипера, моля." means "Pass me the salt and pepper, please." Сол is feminine, so the article is -та.

true_false.name: True or false: Pokrivka
true_false.explanation: Correct. It comes from покривам, "to cover".

fill_in_the_blank.name: In the cupboard
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Чашите са в шкафа до хладилника." means "The glasses are in the cupboard next to the fridge."

lessons.name: Ordering at a Restaurant
lessons.description: Ask for the menu, order Bulgarian dishes and ask for the bill.

multiple_choice.name: Match the restaurant words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: May I have the menu
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Може ли менюто, моля?" means "May I have the menu, please?" "Може ли..." is the easiest way to ask for something.

true_false.name: True or false: Smetkata
true_false.sentence: "Сметката, моля" is how you ask for the bill.
true_false.explanation: Correct. Literally, "The bill, please".

fill_in_the_blank.name: A shopska salad for me
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: За мен една шопска __ и кебапчета.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "За мен една шопска салата и кебапчета." means "For me, a shopska salad and kebapcheta."

fill_in_the_blank.name: What will you order
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Ти какво ще поръчаш за десерт?" means "What will you order for dessert?" Поръчаш goes with ти.

true_false.name: True or false: Bakshish
true_false.explanation: A бакшиш is a tip for the waiter.

multiple_choice.name: Match the Bulgarian dishes
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English name to the Bulgarian dish.

fill_in_the_blank.name: The waiter brings the menu
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Сервитьорът носи менюто на масата." means "The waiter brings the menu to the table."

true_false.name: True or false: Musaka
true_false.sentence: Bulgarian moussaka is usually made with potatoes and minced meat.
true_false.explanation: Correct. Unlike the Greek version, it is made with potatoes rather than aubergines.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Another cold beer
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Може ли още една студена бира?" means "Could I have another cold beer?" Бира is feminine.

lessons.name: The Body
lessons.description: Parts of the body and their unusual plurals.

multiple_choice.name: Match the body parts
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each part of the body to its Bulgarian word.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Two hands
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Имам две ръце и два крака." means "I have two hands and two legs." The plural of ръка is ръце.

true_false.name: True or false: Ochi
true_false.explanation: Correct. Some body parts have old, irregular plurals: око, очи; ухо, уши.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Long hair
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Той има дълга __ и сини очи.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Той има дълга коса и сини очи." means "He has long hair and blue eyes." Коса is singular in Bulgarian.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Washing their hands
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Децата мият ръцете си преди ядене." means "The children wash their hands before eating." With си the noun takes the article.

true_false.name: True or false: Uhota
true_false.explanation: The plural of ухо is уши.

multiple_choice.name: Match more body parts
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each part of the body to its Bulgarian word.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Brushing teeth
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Мия си зъбите сутрин и вечер." means "I brush my teeth morning and evening."

true_false.name: True or false: Usta
true_false.explanation: Correct. "Затвори си устата" means "Shut your mouth".

fill_in_the_blank.name: A broad back
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Той има широк __ и силни ръце.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Той има широк гръб и силни ръце." means "He has a broad back and strong arms."

lessons.name: I Feel Ill
lessons.description: Say what hurts, describe symptoms and talk to a doctor.

multiple_choice.name: Match the symptoms
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: My head hurts
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Боли ме главата." means "My head hurts", literally "The head hurts me".

true_false.name: True or false: Boli me garloto
true_false.sentence: "Боли ме гърлото" means "I have a sore throat".
true_false.explanation: Correct. Literally, "The throat hurts me".

fill_in_the_blank.name: A high temperature
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Имам висока температура и оставам вкъщи." means "I have a high temperature and I am staying at home."

fill_in_the_blank.name: I am ill
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Болен __ и не мога да дойда на работа.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Болен съм и не мога да дойда на работа." means "I am ill and cannot come to work."

true_false.name: True or false: Nastinka
true_false.explanation: A настинка is a cold. A broken leg is "счупен крак".

multiple_choice.name: Match the medical words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: One tablet three times a day
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Пия по едно __ три пъти на ден.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Пия по едно хапче три пъти на ден." means "I take one tablet three times a day."

true_false.name: True or false: Retsepta
true_false.sentence: "Рецепта" can be a doctor's prescription or a cooking recipe.
true_false.explanation: Correct. The same word covers both.

fill_in_the_blank.name: A check-up
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Утре имам преглед при зъболекаря." means "Tomorrow I have a check-up at the dentist's."

lessons.name: Sport for Everyone
lessons.description: Popular sports and what you do to play them.

multiple_choice.name: Match the sports
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each sport to its Bulgarian name.

fill_in_the_blank.name: I play football
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "В неделя играя футбол с приятели." means "On Sundays I play football with friends."

true_false.name: True or false: Igraya futbol
true_false.explanation: Correct. Играя is used for most ball games.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Skiing in Bansko
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "През зимата караме ски в Банско." means "In winter we ski in Bansko." You "drive" skis: карам ски.

fill_in_the_blank.name: My favourite sport
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Любимият ми спорт е волейбол." means "My favourite sport is volleyball."

true_false.name: True or false: Byagane
true_false.explanation: "Бягане" means "running". Swimming is "плуване".

multiple_choice.name: Match the sport words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: A ball for basketball
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Имаш ли топка за баскетбол?" means "Have you got a basketball?"

true_false.name: True or false: Stadion
true_false.sentence: A "стадион" is a place where you watch matches.
true_false.explanation: Correct. The national stadium in Sofia is "Васил Левски".

fill_in_the_blank.name: Three times a week
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Ходя на фитнес три пъти седмично." means "I go to the gym three times a week." After a number, път becomes пъти.

lessons.name: Healthy Habits
lessons.description: Sleep, food and exercise: talk about a healthy life.

multiple_choice.name: Match the healthy words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: I walk every day
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Всеки ден вървя по един час." means "Every day I walk for an hour."

true_false.name: True or false: Zdrave
true_false.explanation: Correct. "Здрав" means "healthy" or "strong".

fill_in_the_blank.name: Eight hours a night
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Спя по осем часа на нощ." means "I sleep eight hours a night." After a number, час becomes часа.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Plenty of water
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Пия много вода всеки ден." means "I drink a lot of water every day."

true_false.name: True or false: Razhodka
true_false.explanation: A разходка is a walk. A meal is "ядене".

multiple_choice.name: Match the habit verbs
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English verb to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: I do not smoke
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Не пуша и не пия алкохол." means "I do not smoke and I do not drink alcohol."

true_false.name: True or false: Nazdrave
true_false.explanation: Correct. It comes from "на здраве", "to health".

fill_in_the_blank.name: More vegetables
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Лекарят казва да ям повече __ и плодове.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Лекарят казва да ям повече зеленчуци и плодове." means "The doctor says I should eat more vegetables and fruit."
